newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil cenbank says won't sell gold stocks - report.
newsitem.headline: Brazil cenbank says won't sell gold stocks - report.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank will not sell its gold stocks, estimated at 266 tonnes, a newspaper reported Monday.

According to Gazeta Mercantil financial daily, the head of the bank's international reserves department, Maria do Socorro Costa de Carvalho, said the gold was considered strategic despite averaging yearly returns of only 2.5 percent.
"For us it's a strategic question," she said. "The stocks are small but important as a fallback in times of crisis."
Neither Carvalho nor Central Bank spokesmen were immediately available for comment.
Gazeta's article ran on the heels of recent gold sales by European central banks.
